partners.mechanism_chain: FLNA (HGNC:3773) —DISRUPTS→ cytoskeletal regulation and cell-matrix adhesion (GO:0007010); cytoskeletal regulation and cell-matrix adhesion (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Intestinal pseudoobstruction (HP:0002072); APOA1 (HGNC:601) —DISRUPTS→ extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198); APOA1 (HGNC:601) —PRODUCES→ APOA1 amyloid fibrils (CHEBI:57730); APOA1 amyloid fibrils (CHEBI:57730) —LEADS_TO→ Amyloidosis (HP:0003203); extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198) —LEADS_TO→ Amyloidosis (HP:0003203).
